dedupe_keys.name: gni bim dataset 224 anonymised ifc building models tum

description: A collection of 224 anonymised IFC building models from the TUM Georg Nemetschek Institute. It has 208 single-discipline models made by students in the BIM Fundamentals master course (winter term 2024/25), each of a specific building shape, and 16 models from nine team projects in the BIM Project master course (winter term 2025/26), seven of them with paired architectural and structural models of the same building. Schemas are IFC2x3 and IFC4. The authors parsed 223 of the files, skipping one 536 MB file, and counted 42 IfcElement subclasses with 290,877 element instances, mostly structural framing (members, plates), openings and proxy components. The release also holds the anonymisation scripts, which strip persons, organisations, addresses and project names from each file, and a CSV listing 35 other online IFC model sources. Access: download from Zenodo, linked from the GitHub repository. Licence and cost: models CC BY 4.0, scripts MIT, free; the models come from coursework and are provided as is, with no warranty of correctness. Caveats: they are teaching models, not real buildings, and cover no site location or hazard data. Useful for testing IFC-to-simulation workflows, model checking and machine learning on building geometry.
